name: mixin-ecommerce-db
description: PostgreSQL/Prisma data layer for the Mixin B2C + B2B (mobile phone distribution) e-commerce platform

scripts.db:reset: prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed && npm run db:generate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:fresh: prisma db push --force-reset --accept-data-loss && npm run db:generate && npm run db:seed
